evidence.ACL: There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: The medial and lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: In the medial compartment, there is longitudinal vertical tear at the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: The lateral compartment, there is vertical longitudinal tear of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is focal high grade chondral injury (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: The patellofemaoral joint appears congruent. There is no cartilage injury.
evidence.Effusion: Minimal amount of left knee effusion is present.
